name: Landhotel Berghof - Schmankerl Stube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Landhotel Berghof – A Culinary Gem in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Landhotel Berghof** invites you to indulge in a world of alpine hospitality and mouthwatering flavors. Our **Schmankerl Stube** is where tradition meets modern comfort, offering a cozy retreat after a day of exploring the breathtaking landscapes around **Innsbruck**, **Ötztal**, or **Zillertal**.

Start your day with a hearty breakfast featuring fresh **Tiroler Bergkäse**, crispy **Speck**, and homemade jams—all paired with the finest local coffee and tea. As the sun sets, savor our signature dishes, from tender **Tiroler Gröstl** to the fluffy, caramelized **Kaiserschmarrn**, served with a dollop of vanilla sauce and fresh berries. For meat lovers, our slow-roasted **Tiroler Rindfleisch** with hand-cut **Knödel** and a rich gravy is a must-try.

After dinner, unwind with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelwein** or a velvety **Vanilleeis** from our in-house kitchen. The **Schmankerl Stube** also hosts seasonal specialties, like wild game stews in autumn or fresh trout from the nearby **Inn** River in summer.

Just steps away from the **Nordkette** and the vibrant city of **Innsbruck**, **Landhotel Berghof** is your perfect base for adventure and relaxation. Whether you’re hiking the **Alpenrose Trail**, skiing the slopes of **Axelbögen**, or simply soaking in the views from our sun terrace, every moment here is a celebration of **Tirol’s** finest flavors and natural beauty.

**Come taste the heart of Tirol—where every bite tells a story.**
